Get a token callback for one Fabric service

Source: R/backend__fabric.R
oauth_db_fabric.Rd

Use this to call a fabricQueryR function directly with the visitor's credentials. It supplies the callback expected by the function's token argument. For several services or resource objects, use oauth_db_fabric_api().

Usage

oauth_db_fabric(
  authorization,
  service = c("fabric", "sql", "dax", "kql", "onelake", "graphql"),
  target = .odb_fabric_profile(service)$target,
  required_scopes = NULL,
  min_valid_for = 60,
  session = shiny::getDefaultReactiveDomain()
)

Arguments

authorization

auth$connection from a shinyOAuth server module, without parentheses. To select a saved authorization, pass a function that calls auth$connection(id).

service

One of "fabric", "sql", "dax", "kql", "onelake", or "graphql".

target

Token target name. Defaults to the service's preset target. Use NULL if the authorization has no named targets.

required_scopes

Additional permissions to check. NULL uses the service's read/query defaults.

min_valid_for

Minimum remaining token lifetime, in seconds, when obtaining a token. Use 0 to accept any unexpired token.

session

Shiny session. Inferred when the helper is created in server().

Value

A reactive function. Call callback() to get the function to pass as fabricQueryR's token argument.

Details

Create the helper inside server(). The callback obtains and renews tokens through shinyOAuth. It stays tied to the authorization that created it.

See also

oauth_db_fabric_api(). vignette("fabric", package = "shinyOAuthDB") has sign-in setup and a complete app.

Other advanced connection helpers: oauth_db_connect(), oauth_db_token()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# Microsoft client configured with services = "kql":
callback <- oauth_db_fabric(auth$connection, service = "kql")
output$rows <- shiny::renderTable({
  fabricQueryR::fabric_kql_query(
    cluster = "https://example.kusto.fabric.microsoft.com",
    database = "Events",
    query = "Events | take 20",
    token = callback()
  )
})
} # }
